name: Fey Dragonet
descr: You have a brightly colored body with gleaming scales that become more lustrous as you age, and iridescent butterfly wings. You can change the coloration and pattern of your wings with a single action to let you blend into an area. When your wings match your environment, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks until your surroundings shift in coloration or pattern. You gain the [fey](/trait/fey) trait and add [Fey](/language/fey) to your list of known languages.

name: Homing Drake
descr: You have a short, stubby nose, and tiny spines that resemble hairs. You might have vividly colored scales or be a dun brown. You can cast the [_know the way_](/spell/know-the-way-player-core) cantrip as an arcane [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2901) at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, you always know the distance and direction to your home. You can designate a new location as your home after you spend 1 week there, but you can have only a single designated home at a time.

name: House Drake
descr: You have bright blue and purple scales, with silvery teeth and claws. Your jaws count as silver and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against [fiends](/trait/fiend). You add [Diabolic](/language/diabolic) to your list of known languages.

name: Pearl Dragonet
descr:
You have pearlescent scales and a round body, with short legs, small wings, and a long tail. The shape of your body lets you absorb a blow and roll away.

**Bounce Away** **Reaction** **Frequency** once per 10 minutes; **Trigger** A melee Strike hits you and deals bludgeoning damage; **Effect** You gain [resistance](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) equal to your level to bludgeoning damage from the triggering Strike, then [Stride](/action/stride-player-core) up to half your Speed. You can [Fly](/action/fly-player-core) instead of Striding if you have a [fly Speed](/rule/fly-speed-rules-2350).

name: Tidepool Dragonet
descr: You have a slender, eel-like body with azure scales. Your wings sweep along your body like massive fins, making you well suited for watery terrain. You gain the [amphibious](/trait/amphibious) trait, and a [swim Speed](/rule/swim-speed-rules-2351) of 15 feet. You add [Thalassic](/language/thalassic) to your list of known languages.
